sources.title: University of Science and Technology Beijing Undergraduate Admission Guide 2026
University of Science and Technology Beijing CSCA Guide 2026

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport, be physically and mentally healthy, and have good conduct.
Hold a senior-high-school diploma recognized by the Chinese Ministry of Education; provide qualification verification if requested.
Be no older than 35 at the application deadline; scholarship routes may impose different age limits.
Submit HSK Level 4 or above.
Apply from November 1, 2025 through June 15, 2026; the system closes after the deadline.
Register in the USTB international online application system, complete personal information, upload clear PDF/JPG materials, pay the fee and submit; no paper package is required.
Complete truthful and complete personal information in the online application; submitted information cannot be modified.
Submit the high-school diploma and complete official high-school transcript. Non-Chinese/English records require official translations and notarization.
Submit the information page of a valid ordinary passport whose validity covers at least one year after expected enrollment.
Submit an HSK Level 4 or higher score certificate.
Submit the designated Foreigner Physical Examination Form issued by a regular medical institution and valid within six months.
Submit the USTB financial-guarantee form with guarantor identity and financial evidence sufficient for one academic year; the guide recommends at least RMB 50,000.
Submit an official no-criminal-record certificate in Chinese or English, or with official translation and notarization, valid within six months.
Submit CSCA Humanities Chinese and Mathematics score reports; Physics or Chemistry is not required for the published humanities-list majors.

references.locator: Section II USTB CSCA Requirements and Section VIII process

requirements.ruleText: Undergo USTB's comprehensive review of application materials, CSCA scores, academic background and language ability; admission is competitive.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 600 application fee.

references.locator: Section V(2)-(3) Fees and Application Method

requirements.ruleText: Pay annual tuition of RMB 23,300.
Purchase the required China medical insurance: RMB 800 per year or RMB 400 per semester; registration is not processed without it.

references.locator: Section V(2) Fee Standards and note 2

requirements.ruleText: Pay RMB 1,500 per month per bed for a double room or RMB 750 per month per bed for a four-person room; students not allocated a room arrange off-campus housing themselves.

references.locator: Section V(2) Fee Standards and note 1

requirements.ruleText: Register at the time in the admission notice and official email and present the original high-school diploma for enrollment qualification review.
Use the Admission Notice and JW201/JW202 to apply for an X1 visa and convert it to a study residence permit within 30 days after arrival.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport, be physically and mentally healthy, and have good conduct.
Hold a qualification equivalent to a Chinese bachelor's degree.
Be generally no older than 40; scholarship routes may impose different age limits.
Pass HSK Level 5.

references.locator: Section I Eligibility and Section V Application Materials item 6

requirements.ruleText: Apply from November 1, 2025 through June 15, 2026; scholarship deadlines follow the individual scholarship notice.
Complete the online USTB application and pay the application fee; paper materials are not required.

references.locator: Opening note and Section IV - Application Method

requirements.ruleText: Complete the application form in the USTB system and pay the application fee.

Submit the bachelor's degree certificate and complete undergraduate transcript as notarized Chinese or English originals; expected graduates may use pre-graduation or enrollment proof but must supply the degree after admission.
Submit a Chinese- or English-language personal statement and research plan of at least 1,000 Chinese characters/words.
Submit two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors; at least one recommender must know the applicant's current field of study.
Pass HSK Level 5.
Submit a copy of a valid ordinary passport.
Submit the designated health/physical-examination certificate.
Submit the USTB financial-guarantee form.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate.
A supervisor acceptance letter may be submitted when available.
Optionally submit a list and abstracts of published articles and other original work.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 600 application fee.
Pay annual tuition of RMB 31,600.
Purchase required China medical insurance at RMB 800 per year or RMB 400 per semester; registration is not processed without it.

references.locator: Section III fee table and note 2

requirements.ruleText: Pay RMB 1,500 per month per bed for a double room or RMB 750 per month per bed for a four-person room; students not allocated a room arrange off-campus housing themselves.

references.locator: Section III fee table and note 1

requirements.ruleText: Register at the time in the admission notice and official email and present original degree/graduation certificates for enrollment qualification review.
Use the Admission Notice and JW201/JW202 to apply for an X1 visa and convert it to a study residence permit within 30 days after arrival.
